title: What Self-Control Actually Means for a Godly Man (It's Not White-Knuckling It)
caption:
A godly man without self-control is a city with no walls.

Proverbs 25:28 isn't an insult. It's a diagnosis. Undefended isn't the same as unworthy, but it does mean it's time to rebuild.

Self-control isn't white-knuckling it at 11 PM. It's the wall you built at 7 AM, before you were tempted. The charger in the kitchen. The text sent before the urge shows up.

You'll know the wall's holding by what you did on a Tuesday nobody was checking, not by how strong you felt on Sunday.

#faith #scripture #christianmen #manofgod #selfcontrol #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
